_: The single manifest of the Perch public package: the privacy guard scans everything
include expands to (dotfiles count), and export-perch.py copies by it. To keep something
out of the scan, the only way is an explicit neverCopy entry with a reason.

neverCopy.**/.omc/**: Local session state; it can carry home paths, executed commands and identifiers, and must never enter public git history.
neverCopy.**/.DS_Store: Per-machine directory metadata written by Finder; it has nothing to do with what the public package does.
neverCopy.**/__pycache__/**: Python bytecode cache directory; its contents can embed absolute paths from the build machine.
neverCopy.**/*.pyc: Python bytecode file; its contents can embed absolute paths from the build machine.
